articulation.label: grandmother
articulation.alt: grandmother: /ɡ/ → /r/ → /æ/ → /n/ → /m/ → /ʌ/ → /ð/ → /ɚ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /ɡ/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; add voice.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
/ð/: Tongue tip at the teeth; add voice.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
